greatest_duration.note: Distinct from greatest eclipse. For total eclipses the two differ by 1-2 s and can be 100+ km apart. Seconds sacrificed is measured against this point.

caveats.delta_t: Computed with delta T = 79.5 s (the value NASA gives on the elements page). delta T is not perfectly predictable and shifts the path east or west.
caveats.lunar_limb: Path limits carry 1-2 km of uncertainty and duration 1-3 s from the lunar limb profile. Limb-corrected predictions appear 12-18 months before an event.
caveats.geonames_coverage: Coverage is uneven by country. Absence of a town here means absence from GeoNames, not absence of a town.

advisories.handling: Attached to the country group, never to individual rows. Nothing is hidden or reordered because of an advisory: a ranking that optimises for duration, clear sky and low crowds will surface places under serious advisories at the top, because on those axes they genuinely win.
